item.title: Powassan Voodoos run into hot goalie in 2-1 loss to Soo Thunderbirds
item.description: Powassan outshot the Soo 39-23 but could only score once as they miss a chance to gain on the Timmins Rock in the race for third place in the NOJHL

item.title: Powassan Voodoos end western swing with important win in Blind River
item.description: The win keeps the Voodoos two points behind the Timmins Rock in the face for 3rd place in the NOJHL

item.title: North Bay Battalion get great goaltending once again from Jack Lisson in 4-2 road win in Ottawa
